message.body:
Dear Mr Lis,

Thank you for your offer and for your clear interest in a long-term partnership. We value that.

Our own data gives us a different starting point:

Your on-time delivery was 63.5% in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70140@2026Q3).

Our orders of Bearing bracket HN with you were placed at EUR 46.33 on 2024-10-18 (po:4500011561-10), EUR 46.33 on 2025-06-20 (po:4500012598-10), EUR 45.15 on 2026-01-19 (po:4500013441-20) and EUR 45.15 on 2026-09-21 (po:4500014429-10): the price has not risen.

We would like to build steady, reliable business together. Please consider our proposal below. It is a serious effort to find common ground, and we stand ready to support dependable, punctual handling on our side.

Best regards

Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.from_name: Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.
message.subject: Re: Quote from Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red
message.body:
Hello,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We offer a price of €49.00 per unit, a quality commitment of 1500 ppm, a chargeback of €500.00 per complaint. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. Our price follows our main cost drivers: LCI-C, PPI-C241, PPI-D351. 

We see your figures, but we cannot give up margin right now. Faster payment would help us more than anything. Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 60 days net. Also we really need you guys to pay on time, late payments hurt our cash flow and make it hard to deliver on time!

We can do the 1500 ppm target if we lower the chargeback to 150 EUR per complaint, and for this setup we can offer 46.50 EUR. That alternative is a price of €46.50 per unit, a quality commitment of 1500 ppm, a chargeback of €150.00 per complaint.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

Quality: We take the complaints seriously; our 8D report is attached.

Freight Forwarder: Our Lieferzeit is 56 days. With overtime we can deliver in 56 days, at a premium.
